capabilities.justification: Collects bounded passphrase, item-password, and echoed item-metadata bytes from the controlling terminal instead of redirectable process stdin.
Writes fixed secret and item-field prompts plus post-secret newlines directly to the controlling terminal.

capabilities.target: Unix termios and Windows console APIs
capabilities.justification: Verifies the native terminal object and disables and restores input echo using platform APIs unavailable through portable Rust I/O.

capabilities.target: operating-system cryptographic random source via rust/csprng
capabilities.justification: Fills caller-owned initialization and encryption randomness without a user-space or deterministic fallback.

justification: CLI-only host boundary for non-redirectable bounded terminal input and fresh operating-system entropy; it performs no configuration, provider, network, environment, or process access.
